item.title: Bryan Norcross: Potential for tropical impacts in Hawaii and the Caribbean this weekend
item.description: A broad tropical disturbance officially tagged Invest 93C by the National Hurricane Center is just over 1,000 miles southeast of the Big Island of Hawaii. It has a well-defined circulation, but thunderstorms are not yet wrapping around the center. The odds are it will organize sufficiently to be designated a tropical depression or storm today or tonight.

item.title: Tropical Storm Cristobal forms with future Dolly likely not far behind in warm waters of Atlantic

Cristobal strengthened from Invest 93L and is moving farther into the Atlantic and poses no threat to land.
